story_core.want: Stop deadly precursor-driven rescue deployments while preserving real rescue capability during a worsening storm.
story_core.why_now: Warnings are arriving before incidents, contain details affected by response decisions, and an ordinary multi-site storm emergency is becoming unavoidable.
opposition: legitimate rescue duty under time pressure
temptation to treat superior Confederation modeling as command
human evidence that acting on warnings can genuinely save lives
story_core.wrong_strategy: Treat precursor content as an external input that can be made safe primarily through isolation/suppression; later risk replacing OES certainty with predictive-model certainty.
story_core.price: People die under both intervention and suppression-influenced decision chains; OES credibility is damaged when Morgen Pass omissions are exposed; Nika pays professional consequences for an unauthorized life-safety disclosure.
story_core.midpoint: A bounded dummy response element appears inside precursor content, proving that response architecture can enter the warning state.
story_core.point_of_no_return: Different legitimate response architectures generate different credible warning states while a real storm emergency requires action regardless of the anomaly.
story_core.climax_choice: Recover centralized prediction-driven control, or accept bounded loss of central control and trust distributed professional judgment using verified present evidence.
story_core.climax_action: Smith and local communications specialists isolate selected relay relationships while Jana keeps lawful operational authority and delegates bounded objectives; local hydro/rescue crews verify a source-blind route to Andrej rather than treating the strongest warning as command.
story_core.resolution: Andrej is extracted alive with lasting functional consequence; the storm is contained; OES doctrine is amended; Morgen Pass is reopened; Nika’s breach is recorded with a revised override path; Confederation advisory closes without jurisdiction; precursor origin remains unknown; Smith returns to Dublin and makes an ordinary promise to his teenage daughter.
story_core.series_hook: Only after resolution: precursor origin remains unknown and Smith’s OES work continues. No cliffhanger may replace the completed case resolution.

character_arc_constraints.SMITH: From doctrine-as-safety to accountable uncertainty and bounded distributed judgment; accepts that his own rules belong inside the causal chain.
character_arc_constraints.JANA_KOVAC: From carrying central responsibility personally to delegating objectives/limits while retaining lawful command accountability.
character_arc_constraints.NIKA_ZUPAN: From disciplined dispatcher preserving anomalous evidence to unauthorized life-safety disclosure, then formal accountability and a better escalation/override path.
character_arc_constraints.TAREN_SOR: Useful scientific advisory knowledge without Earth jurisdiction; learns that how knowledge enters a decision system is itself part of safety.
character_arc_constraints.ANDREJ_KOSIR: Human operational continuity, humor and competence; eventual severe injury creates lasting price without reducing him to a casualty device.
character_arc_constraints.SMITH_DAUGHTER: F1 only: teenage daughter. Preserve existing source relationship beats; invent no mother/custody/household facts.

observable_first: relay connectivity changing what teams can coordinate
avoid: heroic score proving a tactical choice was right
